impact_summary.value: 탈크의 석면 시험 및 원료 규격이 충분하지 않고 공급업체 시험 결과의 신뢰성이 검증되지 않아 원료가 제조에 적합한지 확인할 과학적 근거가 부족하다고 FDA는 지적했다. 품질부서의 규격 관리와 유효기간에 가까운 제품 출하 관행에 대한 우려도 제기했다.

evidence.quote: Because you have not performed appropriate testing that detects asbestos in your talc components, among other things, you failed to assure the acceptability of these drug components for use in manufacture of your drug products.
Based on a review of documents you provided, you released multiple lots of OTC drug products within a few months of expiry, including one released with only 1 month before the drug product expiry.

affected_work.value: Revlon Group Holdings, LLC의 탈크 함유 일반의약품 제조와 탈크 원료의 확인·불순물·미생물 규격 및 시험, 공급업체 COA 검증, 품질부서의 승인·감독, 제품 출하와 탈크 대체 개질 작업이 대상이다.

evidence.quote: Your firm manufactured (b)(4) , an OTC (b)(4) drug product labeled to contain the active drug ingredient (b)(4) . You currently manufacture (b)(4) OTC drug product labeled to contain the active drug ingredient (b)(4) . These drug products listed above are labeled to contain the inactive ingredient talc.
In response to this letter provide an update on your reformulation efforts to move to an alternative not associated with risks of talc.

recommendation.value: FDA는 탈크 모든 원료 로트의 보관검체 시험 결과를 제출하고, 원료 보관검체가 없으면 관련 완제품 배치 보관검체에서 석면을 시험하라고 요구한다. 또한 구성성분 로트별 규격 적합성 시험 및 공급업체 COA 신뢰성 검증 방법, 입고 로트별 최소 1회의 특정 확인시험 약속, 유효기간 내 위험 제품의 전체 위험평가와 석면 가능성이 있는 원료·제품의 안전성 확인 조치를 제시하라고 요구한다. 품질부서의 권한·자원 개선 평가 및 시정 계획과 탈크 대체 개질 진행 상황도 제출해야 한다.

evidence.quote: In response to this letter, provide: Identity, assay and impurity test results from testing retains for all lots of talc (drug component) used in the manufacture of your drug products. Alternatively, if a retain of a component lot is unavailable, perform retain sample testing of all implicated finished drug product batches for asbestos. Provide this information within 30 calendar days of the date of this letter.

Take prompt and appropriate actions to determine the safety of all lots of the component(s) and any related drug product that could contain asbestos. Appropriate actions could include customer notifications and drug product recalls for any contaminated lots.
In response to this letter provide an update on your reformulation efforts to move to an alternative not associated with risks of talc.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days. Specify what you have done to address any violations and to prevent their recurrence.
